Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 136. Category: technique. Rank 1.

Rank 1 Ki technique
Ki Cost: 5 ki
Prerequisites: none
Casting Time: 1 action
Range: 10 foot radius
Chargeable?: no
Duration: Instantaneous
Type: Omni
Send out a pulse of ki outwards from yourself. All
creatures must make a strength saving throw or be
knocked back 10 feet and knocked prone, 5 foot
knockback and no prone on a save.
